headline: Limited evidence state — debut at a venue requiring iron precision
story_hook: No prior starts at Detroit Golf Club and two unavailable trait scores — iron play and driving accuracy — define the evidence state for this projection. What data exists shows approach play near field average and a debut penalty of 2.4 VTS points applied. The viable path exists but is narrow, and a strong finish would require outperforming a low-confidence projection at a venue demanding the two unresolved skills.

venue_fit.text: Approach play at the 46th percentile sits near field average on the venue's primary demand. Iron play and driving accuracy — the second and third most important demands — are unavailable in the current data window.

strengths.label: Approach Play (available signal)
strengths.statement: Approach play at the 46th percentile is the only substantive scoring signal available; it provides the projection floor but no positive venue-fit delta.

weaknesses.label: Key Traits Unavailable
weaknesses.statement: Iron play and driving accuracy — both unavailable in the current window — are the venue's two most heavily weighted demands, removing the primary evidence basis.

win_scenario: A strong finish requires approach play sustaining above its limited sample mean and putting outperforming expectations, compensating for the unresolved iron-play and accuracy signals.
failure_scenario: The projection breaks if approach play regresses below its limited sample average; with no iron-play data available, there is no compensating scoring signal.

projection_explainer.text: The model assigns T4 at low confidence: two of the five scoring traits are unavailable, and a debut penalty of 2.4 points is applied per policy.

form_note: Form data is drawn from fewer than 6 qualifying starts; the available sample is insufficient to establish a reliable trend.
venue_history_note: No prior starts at Detroit Golf Club. No meaningful venue sample exists, and no venue-history delta is applied to this projection.
